scheme_name: Bebe Nanki Laadli Beti Kalyan Scheme
other_conditions: Parents must be permanent residents of Punjab
Girls residing in orphanages or Children’s Homes in Punjab are eligible
Family’s annual income must be less than Rs.30,000 and must be proven by the blue card issued by the Food and Supply Department, Punjab
Benefit is not provided to newly born boys
If the girl child drops out of school, benefits cease for the family
benefits_summary: Provides up to Rs 61,000 in financial assistance per girl, disbursed in stages up to age 18, along with education scholarships.
documents_required: Blue card issued by the Food and Supply Department, Punjab (proof of income)
Application form (provided by District Program Officer)
